nodes.label: MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Embedded MCP server for SEAD reconciliation; provides search_lookup with fuzzy/semantic/hybrid retrieval; feature-flagged via features.use_mcp_server; Phase 1 uses fallback fuzzy search.

nodes.label: RAG Hybrid Reconciliation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Reconciliation strategy class (RAGHybridReconciliationStrategy) that integrates MCP server search into the reconciliation pipeline; registered per entity type via @Strategies.register.
